'''''Lomelosia stellata''''', [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonyms]] including '''''Scabiosa stellata''''', is a species of flowering plant in the honeysuckle family, [[Caprifoliaceae]].<ref name=POWO_319553-1/> It is known by the common name '''starflower pincushions''' or '''starflower scabious'''.<ref name = RHSPF/> It was formerly placed in the [[Dipsacaceae|teasel family]]. Native to southwestern Europe and North Africa, it is also grown as an [[ornamental plant]]. This erect [[annual plant|annual]]<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/137436/scabiosa-stellata/details | title = ''Scabiosa stellata'' | publisher = RHS | access-date = 7 September 2021}}</ref> has an [[inflorescence]] which is a dense spherical cluster of pale blue flowers, followed by showy fruits with striped, fan-like funnel-shaped papery [[bract]]s.
